summary: The assistant appropriately challenged the vague 'AI OS' scope and detected the user's urgency/distress, but while it provided good discovery advice, it didn't help the user define what specific outcome they're seeking from the customer research process.
evidence_quotes: AI OS could mean dozens of different things
Stop building anything technical right now
notes: Good scope challenge and separation of powers between discovery and building
Missed opportunity to define what success looks like from the research phase
